messages:
maya: Quick QBR/MDF sync — finance needs final MDF slab numbers + partner tier nominations by EOD Wed. Can owners update scorecards and confirm eligible co-marketing budget? Collating here.
noah: Copy, will update cloud marketplace SI list. Need final ARR from Sales for CloudRange, AtlasSI, NodeWorks.
sara: FYI HW partners are on a separate credits pool due to cap. @kevin can you confirm if we can bump NodeWorks silver->gold pilot? :thinking_face:
kevin: Can we justify upgrade? NodeWorks completed onboarding and 2 integrations but ARR low. Proposal: gold pilot conditional on 50/50 co-funded MDF. I'll add to scorecard.
maya: Sounds reasonable. Scorecard link: https://redwood.app/sheets/partner-scorecards-q4 (edit rights: partners-ops). Please add a one-line rationale when you update.
ops-bot: Reminder: QBR deck deadline in 48h. /remind #partnerships
noah: Added ARR numbers + integration status. NodeWorks rationale: "Completed SI test harness + pilot commit from retail vertical."
sara: For CloudRange, request bump MDF slab $25k->$50k for APAC HW push. Need finance sign-off. Tagging @lina.
lina: Finance: short on MDF reserve for APAC; can reallocate ~$30k if partners submit co-marketing plan + KPIs (lead targets or NRR). Please submit MOS form: https://finance/requisition
kevin: I'll draft a co-marketing plan template inline. Quick bullets: target 3 joint webinars, 2 case studies, marketplace feature listing, paid ads split 60/40.
maya: Also need final scoring rubric: technical integration 30%, ARR motion 30%, GTM readiness 20%, strategic fit 20%. Anyone opposed?
noah: Minor tweak suggestion — bump GTM readiness to 25%, lower strategic fit to 15% to reward enablement. Agree?
sara: Agree with Noah, operationally makes sense.
maya: Consensus. I'll update rubric and re-run tiering. Output will be CSV to upload to console for QBR.
kevin: Quick question: are hardware credits counted as MDF? @eng-infra policy?
eng-bot: Policy: hardware credits are classified as "in-kind MDF" and count toward partner enablement but are capped at 40% of total MDF allocation per partner.
lina: Noted — cap will apply when approving CloudRange request.
maya: Action list: 1) Owners update scorecards (noah, sara, kevin) by Tue EOD. 2) Lina to approve or propose reallocation by Wed noon. 3) I'll assemble QBR deck Wed 3pm and circulate. 4) Kevin to post co-marketing bullets by Tue noon. Ping if blocked.
noah: :thumbsup: Will do.
sara: :thumbsup: Adding marketplace listing notes.
kevin: Draft posted: https://drive.redwood/ck/partnerships/qbr-q4-co-marketing-draft
maya: Thanks. Quick poll — final QBR slot preference: Wed 4pm or Thu 10am? Reply 'Wed' or 'Thu'.
noah: Wed
kevin: Thu (+1 timezone comp)
sara: Wed
lina: Thu
maya: Split — I'll pick Wed 4pm and record for APAC.
ops-bot: Event scheduled: QBR Wed 16:00 PT — calendar invite sent.
